And then Input Monitoring is the one nobody remembers exists until the global hotkey doesn't fire. What I think we should do is detect all three up front on first launch, show a single checklist screen with a green tick next to each one as it gets granted, and just poll every second or so to update it, because there's no callback for the accessibility one anyway.

Dialogue immediately accessibility is the one where Mac OS, just silently denies you until the user goes into system settings and flips the toggle manually and then input. Monitoring is is the one nobody remembers exists until the global hotkey doesn't fire, what I think we should do is detect all 3 up front on first launch show a single checklist screen with a green tick next to each one as it gets granted and just pull every second or so to update it because there's no callback for the accessibility one anyway.
